# openobserve_users (Data Source)

Lists the users of an OpenObserve organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_users" "all" {}

output "admins" {
  value = [for u in data.openobserve_users.all.users : u.email if u.role == "admin"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source ID.
- `users` (Attributes List) The users found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (Number) Creation timestamp in microseconds.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `first_name` (String) Given name.
- `is_external` (Boolean) True when the account comes from an external identity provider.
- `last_name` (String) Family name.
- `role` (String) Built-in organization role.
